source: The Small / Normal / Large recognizer tiers, read by tools/analyse_selftest.py and the Rubi app's tier choice: change them here only. Weights: the owner's int8 ceilings of 2026-10-14 (Small < 1 MB, Normal <= 1.6 MB, Large <= 2.5 MB), set from v0.8.0-test.1's console timings and kept (2026-10-15) until a test build's console logs confirm larger ones. Box time: the owner's limits of 2026-10-14 for a typical full textbox (box), estimated; where a time limit is tighter than a weights ceiling, the time limit wins. Arena ceilings: bee-san/vita-vn-ocr docs/model-tiers.md, section 1.3. Reserve: a fixed 1 MiB for every model size (owner, 2026-10-23, PR #280; #277's console test build carried it and the owner reports that it works, 2026-10-28; still an estimate, no figures of that run were reported), replacing vita-vn-ocr docs/model-tiers.md section 1.5's untuned 4/8/16 MiB margins after あおかな reported only 3 MiB free. TEST DRAFT (owner, 2026-10-28, "make a build that tests 512kb"): 512 KiB for every model size instead of #280's 1 MiB, in a console test build only; main keeps 1 MiB; 512 KiB is an estimate, untested on a console. Default: Normal (owner, 2026-10-15).
tier_keys: The tier picker's keys (API 21; the analyser ignores them). model: the tier's pinned recognizer in ux0:data/VitaJPOverlay/ocr (include/vjo_vocr_sizes.h VJO_VOCR_TIERn_NAME); a later generation's three blobs replace these through the pins. tagline: the Rubi app's line for it. est_box_ms: est_box_basis, at 333 MHz (what the Rubi app shows); est_box_ms_444: the same estimate at 444 MHz, the clock a job raises by default (ocr_boost_clock). job_bytes: the game's USER memory a first job of the model holds at the full screen, page-rounded weights + workspace + capture block (game_ocr/main.c's memory check), without the character LM, the confidence cascade's model or the PSP refinement, which a job leaves out first when memory is short, and without the helper threads of ocr_threads (API 22), which a job takes only when they also fit beside the same reserve (an estimate from the source, host/tests/test_vocr.c). need_bytes: job_bytes + reserve_bytes, the free game memory the tier needs to run; with less, a job runs the next smaller tier. The C tables (include/vjo_vocr_sizes.h, include/vjo_ledger_budget.h, core/config.c, core/vocr_models.c) hold the same values: tools/tests/test_model_tiers.py checks that they agree.
est_box_basis: Estimated ms to read a typical full textbox (3 lines of about 640 px, 240 CTC frames, greedy decoding, plus 0.1 s for the line finder) with the tier's model on one core of the console, with the paths config.ini ocr_head_gate = on (the default) gives its blob: none for Small (its VOCR6-S blob has no section), Normal's head gate and two-level head, Large's two-level head. bee-san/vita-vn-ocr #157 (vocr6-followup's gate fits with vocr6-final-gate's driver of #146, eval/vocr6_gate.sh; eval/vocr6_results_20261027.json "follow_up_gate"): vita/a9_layers.py under qemu on the shipped blobs, every phase calibrated so that VOCR3-H15 costs its measured 4,941.7 us per CTC frame on v0.8.0-test.1's console logs (333 MHz assumed), no credit for the weights' prefetch, at the development share of frames each path skips: at 333 MHz, the clock without ocr_boost_clock, 627 ms (Small, plain), 918 -> 774 ms (Normal, the gate and the two-level head) and 2,073 -> 1,880 ms (Large, the two-level head); est_box_ms_444 is the same at 444 MHz (ocr_boost_clock, the default), by vita-vn-ocr's cycle model: 495, 714 -> 605 and 1,624 -> 1,470 ms. With ocr_head_gate = off the estimates are the first figures; with gate only Normal's blob has one to run (about 810 ms at 333 MHz). With credit for the prefetch they are 564, 672 and 1,335 ms at 333 MHz, and with ocr_threads' parallel lines a box takes less again. The beam + LM decoder adds well under 1 ms a line, its LM's first load and the confidence cascade more. No console has run a VOCR6 model: these are estimates until a test build's logs recalibrate them.
